title: iPhone Duo Gets Reachability in iOS 27.3 Beta
snippet: With today's iOS 27.3 beta, Apple expanded Reachability to the iPhone Duo. Reachability lets ‌iPhone Duo‌ users shift the content on the left or right side of the outer screen to make it easier to reach with a thumb. Reachability can be turned on or off by going to Settings > Accessibility > Touch > Reachability. It is on by default after updating to the new software.
